exposure: patients on tablet labetalol in the antenatal period
outcome: time taken to reach adequate control of blood pressure
cohort: 162 hypertensive parturients scheduled to undergo emergency Caesarean delivery
finding: While both hydralazine and labetalol achieved similar blood pressure control times, hydralazine was more efficacious, required fewer doses to reach target blood pressure, and was associated with a lower incidence of persistent hypertension.
